page.layout: One page of text, single column; ornamented header above the title; faint show-through from the reverse page in the background (not transcribed); catchword/running head absent; no margin notes.

main_text.head: Lectori Benevolo Salutem.
main_text.p: EX quo tempore, animum adjeci meum, ad Theologiam scribendam Judaicam, illud inprimis mihi semper curæ fuit, ut, quæ, ad hujus pertinerent notitiam, ex ipsis Rabbinorum sectarer monumentis. Cogitabam quippe, quod nunquam certius, tutiusque de Moderna Hebræorum

page.notes: The ornamental rule above the title and the printed header ")o(" are decorative/signature furniture; the large initial E is joined to "X" as printed ("EX"). The final word "orum" is a catchword-like continuation printed at the right margin of the last line, transcribed as printed. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.
